notes: Article on the participle takes the supplied relative *Who* (rule 41).

*into a pool*: אֲגַם is a bare second accusative of result, not the verb's own object (which is הַצּוּר), so the supplied *into* is the nominal's under rule 33 rather than rule 44; the Hebrew's own לְ in the parallel colon corroborates the reading. Head on *pool*.
The segmented 3ms suffix on מַעְיְנוֹ has no English and is `unrepresented` (rule 40); no textual decision is taken on the connecting vowel (rule 9).
